name: karnak-temple-complex-begun
description: Egyptian pharaohs began raising a vast riverside sanctuary to Amun that would be enlarged for some two thousand years.

name: abu-simbel-temples-carved
description: Ramesses II had two temples cut into a Nubian cliff, fronted by four colossal seated statues of himself.

name: parthenon-dedicated-athena
description: Athens dedicated its marble Doric temple to the goddess on the Acropolis, crowning the city's building programme.

name: prophets-mosque-medina-built
description: Muhammad and his followers raised a simple courtyard mosque of palm trunks and mud brick, later enlarged into a great shrine.

name: great-mosque-cordoba-begun
description: An exiled Umayyad prince began a mosque whose forest of horseshoe arches became the heart of Muslim Spain.

name: westminster-abbey-consecrated
description: A Romanesque abbey church on the Thames was hallowed days before its royal founder died, and became the coronation church.

name: florence-cathedral-begun
description: Arnolfo di Cambio laid the foundations of a vast Tuscan cathedral of green, pink and white marble, crowned centuries later by a dome.

name: st-basils-cathedral-completed
description: Ivan the Terrible's church on Red Square was finished, its onion domes of clashing colour commemorating a conquest.

name: st-pauls-cathedral-completed
description: Christopher Wren's domed cathedral rose above London after the old church was lost to fire, finished in his lifetime.

name: sagrada-familia-begun
description: Work started on a Barcelona basilica that Antoni Gaudí took over and reshaped into a soaring, organic, unfinished masterpiece.

name: salt-lake-temple-dedicated
description: Mormon pioneers finished a granite temple with six spires after four decades of building in their desert capital.

name: great-mosque-djenne-rebuilt
description: Builders raised the world's largest mud-brick building on the Bani River floodplain, its walls bristling with wooden beams.

name: coventry-cathedral-consecrated
description: A bold modern cathedral rose beside the ruins of its bombed medieval predecessor as a symbol of reconciliation.

name: hassan-ii-mosque-inaugurated
description: A huge mosque rose on a rock above the Atlantic at Casablanca, with one of the tallest minarets in the world.

name: sheikh-zayed-grand-mosque-opens
description: Abu Dhabi opened a white-marble mosque with more than eighty domes, one of the largest in the world.

name: notre-dame-paris-reopens
description: The Paris cathedral welcomed worshippers again after a devastating blaze and a painstaking restoration of its roof and spire.
